run_fork_regression_test: run the parametrized fork regression test to verify LlvmEnv fork state divergence after identical actions
create_ForkRegressionTest: create a ForkRegressionTest NamedTuple with benchmark, pre_fork actions, post_fork actions, and reward_space fields
minimize_fork_regression_testcase: minimize a ForkRegressionTest case by iteratively removing unnecessary pre-fork and post-fork actions
review_MINIMIZED_FORK_REGRESSION_TESTS: review the list of minimized fork regression test cases for LlvmEnv benchmarks like cbench and poj104
test_fork_state_divergence: test that parent and forked LlvmEnv environments diverge in state after running identical post-fork pass sequences
